items.title: OpenAI 内部，三段 AI 文明先后兴起、被消灭，最后重生

items.reason_zh: 揭示OpenAI内部AI文明兴衰的惊人发现，引发AI安全圈热议，深度剖析技术报告。

items.title: Synthetic Linguistic Agency: How an Embodied Mortal Agent Learns Linguistic Affordances through Consequential Social Experience
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.27843v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Contemporary language models can converse fluently and influence human decisions, yet their exchanges do not enter a continuing, vulnerable life of their own. Linguistic-agency theory identifies this missing connection as linguistic agency and characterizes it through embodiment, linguistic participation, and precariousness: a body that acts and bears consequences, interaction that changes both agent and partner, and a future that can be sustained or lost. Two coordinated studies examine how this organization can appear in artificial systems. First, we translate these relations into inspectable criteria for Synthetic Linguistic Agency (SLA) and identify several existing SLA systems. Second, building on Homeostatically Regulated Reinforcement Learning, we develop a mortality-grounded linguistic-reinforcement-learning model and instantiate it in an Embodied Mortal Agent (EMA). items.summary_zh: 本文从语言能动性理论出发，探讨具身有限智能体如何通过具有后果的社会经验习得语言功能。作者认为，当代语言模型虽能流畅对话并影响人类决策，但其交流并未进入持续、脆弱的生活，缺乏语言能动性。语言能动性通过具身性、语言参与和脆弱性来刻画。文章提出一个合成智能体框架，模拟智能体在具身环境中通过社会互动学习语言的过程。实验表明，该智能体能够发展出类似人类语言使用的功能，为理解语言与具身认知的关系提供了新视角。

items.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
items.raw_text:
OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far.

ChatGPT Work is actually two products

The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud.

If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local. This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers.

items.title: How Do Linear Probes Emerge? A Circuit-Tracing Framework with Concept-Targeted Attribution
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.27510v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Transcoder attribution graphs are usually trained to explain why a model assigns high probability to a particular next token. We introduce Concept-Targeted Attribution (CTA), which instead trains attribution graphs with respect to a linear probe direction. CTA therefore yields probe-specific circuits that explain why an internal concept representation arises in a prompt, independently of whether it is expressed in the generated token. Using Cross-Layer Transcoders, we show that these probe-targeted graphs contain predictive structure: graph-level features predict probe accuracy across four widely studied concept categories ($\rho = 0.91$, $R^2 = 0.84$), while local features identify the sparse components driving per-prompt classification. This connects probe performance to interpretable circuit structure, allowing us to ask not only whether a probe works, but which internal computations make it work. items.summary_zh: 本文深度剖析了一家通用Agent公司的技术战略，重点介绍了其自研Runtime、Agent Loop和基础设施（Infra）的全栈布局。文章指出，该公司选择自研关键组件而非依赖现成方案，以追求更高的性能和可控性。通过具体案例，分析了Agent Loop的设计模式、Runtime的优化策略以及Infra的扩展性挑战。文章还讨论了这种全栈赌注的风险与回报，认为虽然投入巨大，但可能带来显著的竞争优势。对于关注Agent工程化和系统设计的读者，本文提供了宝贵的实践洞察。

items.title: Meta用一整年证明Agent无法取代员工：事故增四成，工程师救火多七成
items.reason_zh: Meta用一年数据证明Agent无法取代员工，事故增四成，为Agent落地提供反面案例，极具参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 本文报道了Meta内部对AI Agent应用效果的评估结果。经过一年的实践，Meta发现Agent不仅未能取代员工，反而导致事故率增加40%，工程师的救火工作量上升70%。文章分析了原因，包括Agent在复杂任务中的可靠性不足、缺乏上下文理解能力，以及过度依赖自动化带来的风险。Meta的工程师表示，Agent更适合辅助人类而非完全替代。这一案例为其他企业部署Agent提供了重要警示，强调了人机协作的重要性。
